mentions.name: Stephanos of Byzantium encyclopedia reconstruction bot
mentions.description: This project runs a bot that scans the surviving version of Stephanos of Byzantium's encyclopedia of people and places, translates it, extracts the proper nouns, and tries to reconstruct what has been lost; it is linked to a companion bot's translation of Pausanias.
mentions.source_excerpt: Stephanos of Byzantium wrote what we would call an encyclopedia of people and places. Most of it has been lost, but shortened versions still exist. I've set up a bot to scan a version of what we have, translate it, extract out the proper nouns and try to figure out what was lost. https://stephanos.symmachus.org/
